mintAuthority.summary: Wintermute USDC Select mints deposit-backed USDC shares and may accrue fee shares. Owner, curator, three allocators and one sentinel control strategy parameters. Seven borrower markets include Wildcat debt-token wrapper v-wmtUSDC and 3Jane USD3; parent USDC mint and freeze powers remain inherited.
